'''2012 European Championship Cedrik Vanderhaegen DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel / Spice Mines Of Kessel}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
